composers_checked.name: Bartók, Béla
composers_checked.note: Complete: six quartets, Piano Quintet, Contrasts from IMSLP; the early Piano Quartet Op. 20 added (recorded, not on IMSLP). Juvenilia without a recording (String Quartet in F, 1898; Scherzo in Sonata Form) not added.

composers_checked.name: Schulhoff, Erwin
composers_checked.note: Complete: four IMSLP pages kept; String Sextet Op. 45, String Quartet No. 0 Op. 25 and Divertimento Op. 14 added (recorded, not on IMSLP); WV numbers of these three not confirmed.

composers_checked.name: Martinů, Bohuslav
composers_checked.note: Complete: 28 IMSLP pages kept (all recorded). Added: String Quartet No. 4, String Trio No. 1, Musique de chambre No. 1 (not on IMSLP); H.139, Serenades 1, 3 and H.334 (IMSLP pages the census missed). Fantasia H.301 (theremin) left out; Trio for flute, violin, bassoon H.265, Nonet No. 1 (fragment) and Piano Quintet H.35 not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Bax, Arnold
composers_checked.note: Complete: 12 IMSLP pages kept. Added: Octet GP 329, Nonet GP 302, Threnody and Scherzo GP 336, Septet GP 337 (IMSLP pages missed by the census) and the Piano Quartet and String Quartet in E major (not on IMSLP). Cello Quintet (1908) not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Enescu, George
composers_checked.note: Complete: 8 IMSLP pages kept (all recorded). Added: Piano Trios in A minor and G minor and Sérénade lointaine (recorded, not on IMSLP). Piano Quintet in D (1896) and the unfinished Piano Trio (1942) not added.

composers_checked.name: Roussel, Albert
composers_checked.note: Complete: six IMSLP pages kept (all recorded); Le marchand de sable qui passe, Op. 13 (IMSLP page missed by the census, nine players) added.

composers_checked.name: Vaughan Williams, Ralph
composers_checked.note: Complete: five IMSLP pages kept. Added: On Wenlock Edge and Merciless Beauty (IMSLP pages the census missed) and four early works recorded by the Nash Ensemble (not on IMSLP). 4 Hymns (voice, viola, piano) is vocal repertoire.

composers_checked.name: Ives, Charles
composers_checked.note: Complete: ten IMSLP pages kept, all recorded. Not added: Adagio sostenuto for English horn, string quartet and piano (2 min) and Scherzo: All the Way Around and Back.

composers_checked.name: Ireland, John
composers_checked.note: Complete: five IMSLP pages kept, all recorded; the Sextet (IMSLP page missed by the census) and Ireland's own quartet version of The Holy Boy added. The Trio in D minor for clarinet, cello and piano (1912-14) was not found recorded.

composers_checked.name: Janáček, Leoš

composers_checked.name: Kodály, Zoltán
composers_checked.note: Complete: three IMSLP pages kept; the benchmark Intermezzo (no IMSLP page) and the 1952 Gavotte added. The duos and the solo cello sonata are out of scope.

composers_checked.name: Debussy, Claude

composers_checked.note: Terzetto kept; Seven Scottish Airs skipped (no recording found). Phantasy Quartet, Sextet in E minor and Three Pieces Op. 2 added (recorded, not on IMSLP). The wind quintets have no strings.

composers_checked.name: Price, Florence
composers_checked.note: Quintet kept; String Quartet No. 2 and Negro Folksongs in Counterpoint added (recorded, not on IMSLP). The unfinished String Quartet in G and the Piano Quintet in E minor fragment are on the same disc but not added.

composers_checked.name: Clarke, Rebecca
composers_checked.note: Piano Trio (benchmark) kept; Dumka added (recorded, not on IMSLP). The four-instrument Chinese Puzzle, Comodo e amabile and Poem for string quartet were not found recorded.

note: BRIDGE: H.3 is 'B major' on Wikipedia, 'B-flat' on the Meridian CD (kept B-flat). MARTINU: the Fantasia for theremin, oboe, string quartet and piano, H.301 (recorded, Timpani 2007) is outside the vocabulary (no theremin). BAX: 'In Memoriam' is GP 190 on IMSLP but GP 179 on the Chandos CD, so the title carries no number. The Trio in One Movement is entered as violin, viola (or clarinet), piano (IMSLP's own title); the census derived clarinet, violin, piano. IRELAND: the key of Piano Trio No. 2 differs between IMSLP (e) and the Decca CD (E major), so its title carries no key. Evidence: floor checks use Deezer album pages (commercial recordings), plus MusicWeb reviews and the Martinů Institute database for a few; Apple and MusicBrainz were not needed. IMSLP facts were read from the shared harvest cache. Janáček's Concertino, Schulhoff's Concertino and Bax's Septet (IMSLP 'concerto?') are chamber works played one to a part and are kept. No benchmark issues found. Not added (no recording or outside the vocabulary): Martinů Fantasia H.301 (theremin), Trio for flute, violin and bassoon H.265; Ives Adagio sostenuto, The Gong on the Hook and Ladder and All the Way Around and Back (scoring ambiguous or very short); Martinů Stowe Pastorals H.335 (no recording found); Enescu Piano Quintet in D; Price's unfinished String Quartet in G.
